description: Canonical machine-readable provenance resolution status. Records whether each provenance-blocked record can proceed to content revision or requires human investigation.

human_actions_required: Add attribution_text to source_attribution block — credit StackExchange author/post
Add upstream source URL (specific StackExchange post)
Add parent lineage trace (specific post ID or dump reference)
Record acquisition origin and ingestion trace
requires_human_investigation.precondition: Attribution text and source URL must be recorded before content revision can begin.

human_actions_required: Add upstream source URL (specific WikiChip article URL)
Add parent lineage trace (specific article reference)
Record acquisition origin and ingestion trace
requires_human_investigation.precondition: License verification must be completed (resolve '(verify)' appendix). Attribution text and source URL must be recorded before content revision.

blocked.blocked_detail: CC-BY-SA-4.0 attribution text, source URL, share-alike tracking, and lineage all missing.
blocked.unblocks_when: attribution_text + source_url + share_alike_notice recorded in record lineage

blocked.blocked_detail: WikiChip license still has '(verify)' appendix. Attribution text, source URL, share-alike tracking, and lineage all missing.
blocked.unblocks_when: license verified + attribution_text + source_url + share_alike_notice recorded in record lineage

provenance_resolution_prerequisites.h3_0003: license verification + attribution documentation (text + URL + share-alike)
